falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern typically features lower highs and failed rallies; a breakout above the prior resistance invalidates the bearish bottoming structure and suggests accumulation rather than distribution

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent VIX compression contradicts the elevated fear regime characteristic of bottom formations; it signals complacency and invalidates the panic-washout component of the pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40bps from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sharp rates rally would indicate flight-to-safety panic or recession pricing, breaking the stagflationary/inflation-sticky dynamics that typically accompany the bottom_2024_aug regime where yields remain elevated or rise during equity weakness

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
